text:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Verify original-seed membership instead of entry count**

When a supplied manifest duplicates one original seed ID while omitting another, `held.length` can still equal thirteen, causing `buildOriginalThirteenSubset` to emit a block labeled as the complete original set even though its found/missed lists cannot cover all thirteen IDs. This corrupts the campaign's self-checking subset evidence; compare the unique held-ID set against every `ORIGINAL_THIRTEEN_IDS` member rather than checking the number of matching entries.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
rationale: Author fixed it: Fixed. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
